title: Manually Reference Tipper Axes Using Operator Station HMI (Visu_Dual_MCP)
summary: Use the operator station HMI to stop the automatic tipping cycle, open the reference screen, and manually reference the required tipper axis(es) when the circled 'R' indicator shows they need referencing.
when_to_use: When maintenance requires manually referencing the tipper axis(es) using the operator station HMI reference screen (Visu_Dual_MCP).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate the operator station HMI to Visu_Dual_MCP (F3), stop the automatic tipping cycle, open the reference screen, and initiate axis movement for referencing.
safety_notes: This procedure is performed on the operator station HMI to stop the automatic tipping cycle before moving axes for maintenance referencing.
access_or_tools_needed: HMI controls: CYCLE STOP, REF, axis selection, '-' button

system_preconditions: Operator station HMI is available and the tipper end effector can be controlled from Visu_Dual_MCP (F3).

visual_references.description: Operator station HMI screen showing Visu_Dual_MCP (F3) and the CYCLE STOP step context for manually referencing axes.
Reference screen showing the circled 'R' indicator next to axis information, axis selection, and the '-' movement start control.

steps.title: Navigate to Visu_Dual_MCP (F3) on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Open the correct operator station screen used to stop the automatic tipping cycle and access referencing controls.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3).
steps.expected_result: The operator station HMI displays the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) with the tipping cycle controls available.
steps.healthy_condition: The "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) is visible and ready for interaction (including the CYCLE STOP control).
steps.failure_condition: The "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) is not displayed, or the expected controls for stopping the tipping cycle are not present.

steps.title: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle
steps.purpose: Stop the automatic tipping cycle before opening the reference screen and moving axes for referencing.
steps.instruction: Press "CYCLE STOP" to stop the automatic tipping cycle.
steps.expected_result: The automatic tipping cycle is stopped (CYCLE STOP is pressed while in Auto tipping cycle context).
steps.healthy_condition: CYCLE STOP is successfully engaged/pressed and the system is no longer running the automatic tipping cycle.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing CYCLE STOP does not stop the automatic tipping cycle.

steps.title: Press REF to open the reference screen
steps.purpose: Open the HMI reference screen where axis referencing is initiated based on the circled 'R' indicator.
steps.instruction: Press "REF" to open the reference screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The reference screen is visible and shows axis information with a circled 'R' indicator next to the axis information.
steps.failure_condition: The reference screen does not open after pressing REF.
stop_or_escalate_if: Reference screen does not open after pressing REF.

steps.title: Check circled 'R' indicator and select axis needing referencing
steps.purpose: Identify which axis(es) require referencing and prepare to initiate movement for the selected axis.
steps.instruction: On the reference screen, check the circled 'R' indicator next to the axis information. If the circled 'R' is clear, that axis needs to be referenced. Select the axis to be referenced.
steps.expected_result: The circled 'R' status is visible next to axis information, and the axis requiring referencing is selected.
steps.healthy_condition: The circled 'R' indicator is visible next to axis information, and the operator selects an axis where the circled 'R' is clear (needs referencing).
steps.failure_condition: The circled 'R' indicator/axis information area is not visible or does not respond as expected.

actions.label: Inspect circled 'R' status
actions.exact_action: check the circled 'R' next to the axis information

actions.label: Select axis needing referencing
actions.exact_action: Select the axis to be referenced

stop_or_escalate_if: Circled 'R' indicator/axis selection area is not visible or does not respond as expected.

steps.title: Press '-' to start movement of the selected axis for referencing
steps.purpose: Initiate the axis movement required to perform referencing for the selected axis.
steps.instruction: Press the '-' button to start the movement of the selected axis.
steps.expected_result: Pressing '-' starts movement of the selected axis for referencing.
steps.healthy_condition: Axis movement begins after pressing '-' for the selected axis.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing the '-' button does not start axis movement for the selected axis.
stop_or_escalate_if: Pressing '-' does not start axis movement for the selected axis.

success_criteria: Reference screen opens after pressing REF.
Circled 'R' indicator next to axis information is visible and the operator selects an axis where the circled 'R' is clear.
After selecting the axis, pressing '-' starts movement of the selected axis for referencing.
healthy_conditions: Reference screen is visible with circled 'R' indicator next to axis information.
Axis movement begins after pressing '-' for the selected axis.
failure_conditions: Reference screen does not open after pressing REF.
Circled 'R' indicator/axis selection area is not visible or does not respond as expected.
Pressing '-' does not start axis movement for the selected axis.
escalation_guidance: If the reference screen does not open after pressing REF, or if pressing '-' does not start axis movement for the selected axis, stop the procedure and escalate for assistance.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Visu_Dual_MCP (F3) screen context and CYCLE STOP control for stopping the automatic tipping cycle.
Reference screen showing REF button context, circled 'R' indicator next to axis information, axis selection, and '-' movement start control.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Steps 1-2: Navigate to "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) and press CYCLE STOP.
Steps 3-4: Press REF to open reference screen; check circled 'R' next to axis information; select axis needing referencing.
Step 4: Press '-' button to start movement of the selected axis.
